_readme: All team-written narrative lives here. Every value that starts with TODO-TEAM is a slot for you to write: replace the whole string, keep the key. Do not contradict the PDFs (content/canon.json). One slot per line so the slot list can point at exact line numbers. CANON TIMELINE to stay consistent with: 23 Oct, huge energy spike; 23 Oct 22:31, Agents Nano and Mega meet POI-1 at the machine (Transcript A); after he leaves, the machine warbles; 24 Oct, the game source code is obtained and a character class is missing; 25 Oct 23:54, Agent Nano's Progress Assesment Log: POI-1 was not a cosplayer, the character escaped into the real world. Canon does NOT say why he escaped or where he went: leave that open (it is Nano's question, and the Case #2 hook).
